headings: (125 G) FLEUR DE MANDARINE SCENTED CANDLE | 0FR. PARIS

jsonld_raw.name: (125 G) FLEUR DE MANDARINE SCENTED CANDLE | 0FR. PARIS
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.
Fleur de Mandarine | A vibrant and comforting fragrance where the citrus freshness of mandarin and orange blends with a spiced heart of green tea and nutmeg, set against a sweet and enveloping base of vanilla and mandarin jam.

Notes:
Top notes: mandarin, orange.
Heart notes: green tea, nutmeg.
Base notes: vanilla, mandarin jam.


The candle comes in a colored glass container. Cylindrical design with line details and a contrasting 0fr. Paris logo.

0fr. Paris is an independent bookstore, art gallery, publishing house, and cultural space founded in 1996 in Paris.
